**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Malignant Melanoma of Upper Aerodigestive Tract,* pages 51-53.

**Note 2:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Anterior 2/3 of Tongue, Tip, Border and Tongue, NOS* chapter on page 38 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=38).
